```sql
/* Считаем количество школ с прямым чартерным финансированием среди школ со средним баллом по математике выше 560 */
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.avgscrmath > 560
  AND s.fundingtype = 'Directly Funded'
```

/* Извлекаем имена администраторов (первое имя) и их округа, считаем частоту */

    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" AS district
    FROM schools
    WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" AS district
    FROM schools
    WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname3") <> ''
)
SELECT an.first_name, an.district, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM admin_names an
GROUP BY an.first_name, an.district
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 2;
```

SELECT AVG(ss."numtsttakr") AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."city" LIKE '%Fresno%'
  AND s."opendate" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s."opendate") = 1980;

/* Получаем школу с 7-й по величине средней оценкой по математике */
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.sname,
        s."School Name" AS school_name,
        s."Street" AS street,
        s."City" AS city,
        s."Zip" AS zip,
        s."State" AS state,
        sc.avgscrmath,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sc.avgscrmath DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM satscores sc
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sc.cds
    WHERE sc.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    street,
    city,
    state,
    zip
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 7;
```

LIMIT 1
```

/* Находим округ (county) с наибольшим числом закрытых школ */
WITH closed_schools AS (

        s."school",
        s."closeddate"

),
county_counts AS (

    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),

    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs."county" = tc."county"
ORDER BY cs."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST
```

```

/* Находим самую старую мифическую карту по originalreleasedate и её легальные форматы */
SELECT
    c."originalreleasedate" AS release_date,
    l."format" AS play_format
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'mythic'
  AND l."status" = 'legal'
  AND c."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."originalreleasedate" <> ''
  AND c."originalreleasedate" = (
      SELECT MIN(c2."originalreleasedate")
      FROM "cards" c2
      WHERE c2."rarity" = 'mythic'
        AND c2."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
        AND c2."originalreleasedate" <> ''
  )
ORDER BY l."format" ASC NULLS FIRST;
```

/* Проверяем, выпускалась ли карта "Angel of Mercy" в наборе, доступном на Magic: The Gathering Online */
SELECT DISTINCT
    c."name",
    s."name" AS set_name,
    s."mtgocode"
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s
    ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%Angel of Mercy%'
  AND s."mtgocode" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."mtgocode" <> ''
```

/* Карты художника Jim Pavelec и текст их рулингов */
SELECT
    c."name" AS card_name,
    r."text" AS ruling_text,
    CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 1 THEN 'has missing or degraded properties and values'
         ELSE 'does not have missing or degraded properties and values'
    END AS property_status
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" LIKE '%Jim Pavelec%'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."text" ASC NULLS FIRST;
```

/* Процент карт с японским переводом, доступных только в non-foil */
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c."isnonfoilonly" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN st."language" = 'Japanese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st
    ON st."setcode" = c."setcode"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese';
```

FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON c."uuid" = fd."uuid"
WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1;

FROM stats;

WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

/* Вычисляем потребление в EUR по сегментам за 2012 и 2013 годы */
WITH yearly AS (

        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),

    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN consumption END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN consumption END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),

    SELECT
        segment,
        ((cons_2013 - cons_2012) / cons_2013) * 100 AS pct_increase
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE cons_2012 IS NOT NULL AND cons_2013 IS NOT NULL
)

FROM pct
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

/* Сегмент с наименьшим процентным ростом */
SELECT segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
ORDER BY pct_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
```

/* Находим клиента, который заплатил 634.8 25 августа 2012 года */

),

    SELECT
        ym."customerid",

    JOIN target_customer tc ON tc."customerid" = ym."customerid"

    GROUP BY ym."customerid"
)

FROM consumption_by_year c;
